name: Bangladesh Post postcode booklet — Mymensingh Division post offices (scan on post.rajshahi.gov.bd)

attribution: বাংলাদেশ ডাক বিভাগ (Bangladesh Post Office) — DPMG Rajshahi Division portal
notes: Same undated scanned booklet as the earlier division runs (no text layer). Mymensingh Division's offices are in the booklet's Dhaka region: p. 12 (PDF page 8, left half: 'জামালপুর জেলা ২০০০-২০৯৯', 'শেরপুর জেলা ২১০০-২১৯৯', 'ময়মনসিংহ জেলা ২২০০-২২৯৯', up to 'কিশোরগঞ্জ জেলা ২৩০০-২৩৯৯', Dhaka Division, already collected) and p. 13 (PDF page 8, right half, first column: 'নেত্রকোনা জেলা ২৪০০-২৪৯৯'); only these were transcribed, by hand, from raw/postcode_booklet_pp12-13.png (PDF page 8 at its native 150 dpi, rotated; the same file as in the Sylhet folder). fetch.py verifies the PDF hash (unchanged) and re-emits the transcription. The booklet prints Bokshiganj (2140) under Sherpur and Dhobaura (2416, 2417) under Netrokona: they carry their seed districts (Jamalpur, Mymensingh) and a note. Dharmapasha (2450) and Madhyanagar (2456), printed in the Netrokona section, are in Sunamganj District (Sylhet Division) and are left out. All 78 codes are legible; six faint codes and four uncertain name readings are flagged. Branch post offices are not in the booklet.
